Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling westbound in the left lane on a League City roadway when the vehicle crossed the center line
and struck the eastbound vehicle operated by Driver 2 nearly head-on. Both vehicles sustained front-end damage
consistent with the impact described by the parties, and the crumpling of the front bumpers, hood and airbag
deployment in the Driver 1 vehicle matched the force reported at the scene. Driver 1 was the policyholder of record,
and Passenger was seated in the front right seat. Driver 1 stated that his head snapped forward and back during the
collision and that he felt neck pain shortly afterward. Driver 2 and two independent witnesses gave consistent
accounts of how the collision occurred, and their statements were supported by photographs taken at the scene. Both
drivers and Passenger were identified and confirmed present in their vehicles. No prior damage to either vehicle was
observed or reported by any party. Driver 1 was transported by EMS for evaluation of neck strain and released to a
family member at the hospital.
